Its structure can be broken into three logical fragments that can be joined together: the benzene ring, the acetoxy substituent, and the carboxylic‑acid substituent.  Their SMILES strings are:

- benzene: c1ccccc1  
- acetoxy group (‑O‑C(=O)C): OC(=O)C  
- carboxylic‑acid group (‑C(=O)O): C(=O)O  

These fragments can be linked on the benzene ring to give the full SMILES CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O.  The answer is therefore the list of the three fragment SMILES. </thought>
